title: Profile Settings
description: Manage your account security and preferences

name_change.title: Display Name
name_change.description: Update the name shown across your account.
name_change.success_message: Your name has been updated successfully

validation.first_name_min: First name must be at least 2 characters
validation.first_name_max: First name must be less than 50 characters
validation.last_name_min: Last name must be at least 2 characters
validation.last_name_max: Last name must be less than 50 characters

password_change.title: Change Password
password_change.description: Set a new password for your next sign-in.
password_change.success_message: Your password has been changed successfully. Make sure to use your new password the next time you sign in.
password_change.error_default_message: Unable to update your password. Please verify your current password is correct and ensure your new password meets the security requirements.

validation.new_min_length: New password must be at least 8 characters
validation.new_different: New password must be different from your current password

mfa.title: Two-Factor Authentication (MFA)
mfa.description: Enhance your account security by requiring both your password and a verification code sent to your email address when signing in. This significantly reduces the risk of unauthorized access.

inline.enabled_message: Email verification is active for future sign-ins.
inline.disabled_message: Add one more step to protect your account.
inline.enable_prompt: Confirm your password to start email verification.
inline.disable_prompt: Enter your password to remove the extra sign-in check.

setup_guidance.title: Add a second verification step
setup_guidance.description: Enable email-based verification to protect sign-ins from password-only access. Setup takes a moment and stays tied to your current email address.

how_it_works.title: Setup steps
how_it_works.step1: Click "Enable MFA" to start the setup process
how_it_works.step2: Enter your password to confirm your identity
how_it_works.step3: A 6-digit verification code will be sent to your registered email address
how_it_works.step4: Enter the code from your email to complete the setup and activate MFA
how_it_works.step5: Future logins will require a code sent to your email for verification

confirm_identity.title: Confirm Your Identity
confirm_identity.message: To enable two-factor authentication, please enter your current password to confirm your identity. This is an important security measure to ensure you're the account owner.

code_sent.title: Verification Code Sent
code_sent.message: A 6-digit verification code has been sent to your email address {{email}}. Please check your inbox (and spam folder) and enter the code below to complete the setup.

protected.title: Protected and Secure
protected.message: Your account is currently protected with two-factor authentication. Each time you sign in, a verification code will be sent to your registered email address for added security.

disable_warning.title: Security Warning
disable_warning.message: Disabling two-factor authentication will significantly reduce your account's security. Your account will only be protected by your password. Please enter your password to confirm this action.

notifications.enabled_message: Next time you log in, you'll need to enter a verification code from your email.
notifications.verified_message: Success! Your account is now protected with two-factor authentication. You'll need to enter a verification code from your email each time you sign in.
notifications.disabled_message: Two-factor authentication has been successfully turned off. Your account security has been reduced. We strongly recommend re-enabling MFA to protect your account.
notifications.auth_failed_message: Unable to verify your password. Please check your password and try again.
notifications.verify_failed_message: The verification code you entered is invalid or has expired. Please request a new code or check your email for the most recent one.
